title: Fix Style cadence when repeater settings are not plain arrays
description: Repair the Elementor editor cadence bug where Range controls disappear from Style even though a range filter is rendered.
objective: Make the editor helper flags read filter repeater data robustly and avoid clearing type flags when the current filter rows cannot be resolved.
inputs_required: Guilherme screenshot showing rendered range with missing Range Style section
expected_outputs: Editor filter-row reader supports plain arrays, Backbone-style collections, model arrays, and object maps
Style flag sync does not clear type flags when filters cannot be read
Range Style section can appear when a rendered range filter exists
acceptance_criteria: A range filter no longer disappears from Style solely because the Content repeater DOM is not visible.
The sync still hides type-specific sections when a readable filter list does not include that type.
Guilherme still performs final Elementor panel QA.
verification: JS syntax check passes for assets/js/eit-editor.js.
Plugin PHP lint passes because Elementor control registration is part of the affected behavior.
git diff --check passes in root and plugin.
Static checks confirm the sync has an unreadable-filter guard.
risks: Elementor panel refresh timing still requires Guilherme's visual QA.
The fix is defensive because the harness cannot see the full editor interaction trace.
